question: An air-filled parallel plate capacitor with square plates of side $L$ and separation $d$ is charged to a potential $V$ and then isolated. A dielectric slab of the same dimensions (side $L$, thickness $d$) and mass $m$, with dielectric constant $K$, is placed at the edge of the capacitor and released from rest. Assuming no friction, what is the speed of the slab when it is fully inside the capacitor?
